en: The postcard shows an old, colorized photograph of a grand house behind a white picket fence, framed by two monumental columns and surrounded by trees and smaller secondary buildings. At the top of the photo, printed in red, is the text: 'Direktörsbostaden, Kubikenborg.' The reverse side features handwritten Swedish text, address lines, and a green Swedish 5 öre stamp postmarked 1912. The postcard is divided for correspondence and address, and the sender is congratulating someone named Maria Westin in Bjästa.
